ambiguities.text: No specification for handling reorgs that cross the fork boundary
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard reorg handling applies - if chain tip moves below fork block, revert to Byzantium rules for validation

ambiguities.text: No explicit ordering requirement for enabling the 5 constituent EIPs
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all 5 EIPs activate atomically at the same block - no intermediate states

implicit_assumptions.description: All client implementations correctly implement the fork block numbers for each network
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chain split - nodes disagreeing on fork timing would reject each other's blocks

implicit_assumptions.description: Node operators upgrade their software before the fork block is reached
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded nodes would reject Constantinople blocks and fork onto a minority chain

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient mining/validator support exists for the new chain rules
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contentious fork could result in chain split and two competing networks
